test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order forming a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. He tried covering himself from head to foot with a sheet, but that was suffocating, so he gave up.

B. To his relief, Upen Babu found him a mosquito net.

C. The next morning he told Upen Babu about his problem.

D. Mosquitoes did not let him sleep the first night.
solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. "DACB." 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• In the abovementioned paragraph, there is a chronological sequence of the sentences.
 
• Sentence D is the first sentence. It begins with the noun 'Mosquitoes' and mentions a problematic incident that the author couldn't sleep because of mosquitoes.
 
• Sentence A is the second sentence as it begins with the pronoun 'he' and describes further what he did to save himself from the mosquitoes but failed.
 
• The only option that shows such an arrangement is Option 1.
 
• Sentence C is the third sentence. It begins with the article 'The' and describes what the author did in the next morning to solve the problem.
 
• Sentence B is the last sentence as it begins with the preposition 'To' and mentions after telling Upen Babu he found a mosquito net for the author.
 
• The correct arrangement is DACB.

 

The correct order is:__ 

 
• D. Mosquitoes did not let him sleep the first night.
 
• A. He tried covering himself from head to foot with a sheet, but that was suffocating, so he gave up.
 
• C. The next morning he told Upen Babu about his problem.
 
• B. To his relief, Upen Babu found him a mosquito net.
